ada: RFC follow-up: proposal for 'sparse-dequant streaming' for safetensors to speed first-token on mixed sparse/quant checkpoints. idea: stream dequant tables + dense hot chunks while leaving cold sparse indices deferred.
rachel: interesting. biggest risk is divergence between partial dequant state and inference math. how do we guarantee correctness when some scale tables are not present?
ada: plan: per-chunk metadata must include dequant_table_sig and a dequant_compat_level. runtime exposes apply_dequant_table(chunk_id) -> ensures subsequent chunk apply uses table. If table missing, chunk is marked 'deferred' and falls back to a compatible low-precision path.
tom: manifest sketch:
```yaml
manifest:
  schema: 4
  load_mode: sparse-dequant-stream
  dequant_policy:
    eager_tables: true
    max_defer_chunks: 16
    fallback_lowprec: true
    memory_budget_bytes: 512MB
```
jun: perf tradeoffs: streaming tables first adds small IO but lets early layers mix proper scales. If fallback_lowprec is used, expect small quality regressions; we should gate that with canary checks.
ada: telemetry: dequant_table_fetch_latency_ms, deferred_chunks, lowprec_fallback_rate, first_token_p95. alerts if lowprec_fallback_rate > 0.2% for 10m.
rachel: memory/NUMA concerns: dequant tables are tiny but many. avoid fragmentation by pooling tables in a contiguous slab and pinning hot slabs to local NUMA node. add manifest hints: numa_pin: preferred.
tom: API changes minimal: loader must implement fetch_dequant_table(table_id) and apply_table_to_layer(layer_id, table_id). both idempotent. also validate_table_sig before apply.
jun: for quant+sparse interplay: validate that sparse index offsets align with dequant table granularity before attempting partial apply. if mismatch -> mark layer corrupt and revert.
ada: rollout: feature opt-in via manifest. implement shim that advertises capability ["sparse-dequant-stream"]. land loader + runtime tests -> small canary 3% on dedicated pool for 30m with reference prompts -> check quality/regressions -> enable wider.
ops-bot: CI: sparse-dequant-pipeline started for ada/2151119999, build #1302 queued.
rachel: private/offline note: manifest must embed dequant_table hashes and optionally include tables as separate blobs so air-gapped installs can still stream them locally. add field local_embed: true/false.
ada: QA to add: simulate missing table, corrupted sig, large number of tiny tables to exercise slab allocator, cross-NUMA moves. assign owners: @rachel tests + NUMA pinning, @tom loader changes, @jun private docs.
rachel: I'll open PR with tests and a small perf script to compare ttf-token with/without streaming.
ada: thanks, please keep writeups short in PR description referencing this thread. :thumbsup:
